description: Check whether an hourly rate of pay meets the UK minimum wage for the worker’s age, and apprenticeship, on a date from 1 April 2024, and give the rate that applies.

apprentice.description: Whether the worker is an apprentice, and if so whether in the first year of the apprenticeship.

date.description: The day the pay is for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

hourlyPence.description: The pay for an hour, in pence.

pastSchoolAge.description: Whether the worker is over compulsory school age (past the school-leaving day of the year they turn 16).

name: check_minimum_wage
title: Minimum wage check
